description: A skill claimed by the user. Can be endorsed by other users via id.sifa.endorsement.

main.description: Record representing a single professional skill.

subCategory.description: Optional user-defined grouping label nested under category (e.g., 'Frontend', 'Backend', 'Databases'). Freeform: unlike category there are no known values, so renderers can present skills in the user's own groups. Renderers decide the display label.

tools.description: Tools the owner uses for this skill, for expertise tied to a specific tool. Each entry is a URI reference to a tool item record owned by the same DID. Consumers ignore entries that do not resolve.

contexts.description: Where the owner uses this skill: for work, in private life or as a hobby, or both. Set by the owner, never inferred from the skill or its tools. Absent or empty means unspecified. A display hint only: it does not make the skill or anything else private, and all records are public.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was originally created.
